summary.reading: A warned site compiles to dispatchGuestBranch with the computed target, which looks it up in the function table. 'ran' is from the trace: sites that ran reached only registered targets when their 'missing' is 0; sites not reached did not run on this route (the trace sees every indirect dispatch with PS2X_FAST_DISPATCH=0). No missing-target or unlisted-resume report in a log means the entry list held every branch target and resume point of that run.
